Hi all — happy to take point. Proposed routing and sequencing based on similar customers: 

Routing: Counsel-to-Counsel is fine; we can accept a routed NDA or, if you prefer fast execution, we can provide a DocuSign link.

Sequencing and expected turn times (typical):
- NDA (mutual): initial review / signature-ready copy within 1-3 business days. If you have standard ACME NDA language, we can accept or sign with minimal edits.
- DPA (data processing addendum): 3-5 business days for initial redline review. If ACME needs specific data residency clauses, please highlight them up front.
- MSA / commercial terms: 5-7 business days for a first redline pass from our side; total cycles depend on negotiated points (payment terms, indemnity, liability caps).

Redline sequencing suggestion: 1) NDA signature to enable sharing SOW/PO details; 2) DPA review in parallel with initial procurement conversations; 3) MSA negotiations after scope and pricing are agreed. That tends to reduce rework.
